records.rawDisplayText:
The following obsidian vault is a shared vault between me and my friends (restriction: I cant edit the wiki notes of my friends) where we have a fandom like wiki page for our pathfinder 2e kingmaker campaign. This obsidian vault is then displayed on our quartz 5 website (restriction: No AI instruction file can be visible on the website)

I want to be able to use agents in this vault without risking editing files that are not mine to edit, therefore I want to make sure the agent can only edit my files.

My current files are the following: 
- Every file under the folder aurelius
- The note the church of the eternal blazing sun
- Every file under the folder of The chancelleries 
- The note Tattoos of penance
- All notes currently under (so not always) the non player character folder. 
Furthermore files such as as index, and files under templates are all of ours to edit.

Please find the best solution to make sure this happens.

Here is my proposed solution, if you find a better solution please use that instead. 
- Use the .gitignore file to add an agent instruction file, so that these instructions are only on my local pc rather than the github page
- Write an agent instruction file that is perfectly suited for this type of project (creative concept writer for a pathfinder 2e kingmaker campaign etc etc.) with the given restriction, with a way to identify files which are editable by the agent and not editable by the agent
- Give all the files that are editable this identification marker (not the other way around, as the agent cant keep track which files arent editable by him), make sure all future files by the agent contain this mark
- Set in place failsafes so that the agent is unable to edit the other files/changes are easily reversible
